comparison.objective: Apply a complete opaque primer coat without drips; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Load, rim-wipe, and stroke a flexible brush while managing finite paint volume, versus precision hex/collar manipulation and iterative guarded impact tests.
comparison.success_condition: At least 95% of patches must be opaque with at most one drop, no bench brushing, and the brush released for full score; candidate requires two safe repeatable stops within mechanical limits.
comparison.reason: Material deposition and spill control are meaningfully different from adjustment locking and dynamic-response tuning.
